name: Shou Otori
source: Shou is the quiet type, keeping most of his thoughts to himself. Although not as extroverted as his brother, his presence in bosh academics and athletics have earned him some popularity of his own. Though he tries not to make it obvious, he has a crush on Nerisu that everyone can see except the target of his affections.
